text.text_excerpt: Seersucker is the best new restaurant of 2015. I realize it's only August, but trust me on this. If you spent any amount of time on the West Bank during lunch time you had probably been to, or at least heard of Donewar's in Gretna. When Donewar's closed I lost one of my favorite lunch spots, and the metro area lost one of the best roast beef po-boys. Located in the same building that Doenwar's operated from for so many years, Seersucker has not only filled the void left by the closing, they have actually improved significantly on a place I truly loved. Now that the history lesson is out of the way, I will explain why Seersucker is so great. The Atmosphere This building was an old neighbor...

Seersucker may have just replaced my go to lunch spot for a salad or po-boy while I'm at work. The salads are super fresh and the po-boys are always overflowing with seafood and toppings. I must say I'm a sucker for their fried green tomatoes and onion rings as well. You really can't go wrong with anything on the menu! Plus they have these variations of poy-boys that my coworkers seem to love....like roast beef topped with fried shrimp for example. And you can't go wrong with the New Orleans daily specials...Red beans, white beans, meatloaf, spaghetti and meatballs etc etc....There's something for everybody. A pretty nice sized place in Gretna that is starting to get a ton of traffic.

This place is awesome!! I wish they were open for lunch on the weekends. Their roast beef poboys are up there with the absolute best in the city. Great, friendly service. I'm still eating my way through their menu but I haven't come across a single item I haven't enjoyed. Truly a hidden gem in McDonoghville.
